arguments.message: Project: /mnt/f/LaTeX/BVE research. External work area: /mnt/f/tools/math-audit-round6-20260921. Baseline HEAD92d46e99e36cc0a74e8f7bb13430749c222ee54f. Independently verify this route before using it; never claim a growth lemma kills every solution without its actual initial hypotheses. Finally prove the representer inclusion equivalence and x²+x³ / x²-x³ counterexample, retaining the master criterion. Complex Hilbert inner product is linear in the first variable. Abstract spaces here admit ALL monomials and are not the constrained Krein graph domain; make this scope distinction explicit. Keep other historical branches out of certification. Write detailed proof, explicit quantifiers and source locators. Save external AUTHOR_NOTES.md and a compact exact/symbolic check script/results if useful for a genuine arithmetic or indexing risk.
